_comment: Products and formats offered by the documentation download widget. Consumed by build/make_doc_bundles.py (which names the .tar.gz files) and by layouts/partials/download-docs.html (which renders the picker), so the two always agree. The order of 'docsets' is the order the picker lists them in, and mirrors the docs sidebar: the Redis products run in the same sequence there. 'path' is relative to the site root, 'exclude' paths are relative to 'path', and 'versions' names the version list CI writes to <key>-versions (see .github/workflows/main.yml).

formats.label: Markdown
formats.description: The same rendered Markdown that redis.io serves to AI agents. Best for offline reading, grepping, or dropping into a repository.

formats.label: Markdown, single file
formats.description: All the pages of a product concatenated into one file. Best for pasting into a model's context window or a Claude project.

formats.label: HTML
formats.description: The pages as published, with their styling, fonts, and images included and their links rewritten to work from disk. Open index.html in a browser.

formats.label: JSON
formats.description: Structured per-page documents (title, description, table of contents, code examples, body). Best for search indexes and RAG pipelines.

docsets.title: Develop with Redis
docsets.description: Clients, data types, programmability, and Redis for AI. RedisVL is listed separately.

docsets.title: Libraries and tools
docsets.description: Client libraries, observability, and cloud integrations. Redis Data Integration is listed separately.
